name: FloatingLines-TS-TW
title: Floating Lines
description: Soft bands of violet-blue light float across a dark magenta haze, bending and crossing as they drift. The pointer pushes the nearest lines so the ribbons flex around it.
use: A dark hero wants soft glowing bands behind a headline instead of a photo.
avoid: The haze lifts the whole surface, so white overlay text needs a contrast check.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with no labels; its continuous drift ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Broad ribbons of glowing violet and blue light sweep low across a hazy dark purple field. The brightest strands read almost white at the core and fade into a soft magenta wash.
behaves: The ribbons drift and bend slowly, crossing one another as their waves shift. Moving the pointer bends nearby lines and slides the whole scene a little.
customise: Gradient colours, which wave layers show, line counts and distances, wave positions, speed, bend and parallax are props; the shader itself is fixed.
weight: heavy: A fullscreen shader is redrawn every frame on a three.js canvas.
demo: Purple-violet light lines on a dark haze with nothing else on the panel.
polishWhy: Glowing ribbons with a rich, smooth gradient; bands are soft and the palette is one purple family.
